guide.aetherium.page.1:
§5KRYZORAE CODEX§r

A guide to exploration, equipment and bosses.

This edition describes content already available. Future expansions will add more chapters.
guide.aetherium.page.2:
§5FIRST STEPS§r

Find Kryzorae ore in deep caves. Mine it and smelt the raw material into ingots.

Prepare your equipment before entering dangerous areas.
guide.aetherium.page.3:
§5VIOLET SWORD§r

Swing to release an energy slash travelling about 5 blocks.

Slashes have a 0.45 s cooldown and stop when they reach solid blocks.
guide.aetherium.page.4:
§4CRIMSON SWORD§r

Successful hits apply Bleeding. Up to 3 stacks deal 2, 4 or 6 health points per second.

Bleeding stacks are rate-limited against bosses.
guide.aetherium.page.5:
§5RIFT GUARDIAN§r

Use the Guardian Sigil on a solid block to summon the boss.

Dodge its charges and shockwaves. Its Rift Core helps craft the next summon.
guide.aetherium.page.6:
§4WINGED EXECUTIONER§r

The Astral Seal needs materials from the Guardian.

The Executioner uses charges, iron feathers and mirages. Its drops help forge astral gear.
guide.aetherium.page.7:
§5USEFUL TOOLS§r

The magnet pulls nearby items when enabled.

The flare highlights nearby enemies and grants night vision. Some accessories support optional Curios.
guide.aetherium.page.8:
§5FUTURE EXPANSIONS§r

This book will grow as new ores, forges, armor and creatures are added to the game.

Check recipes in Minecraft or JEI if installed.
